page.overview:
Who is Alphonse Delacroix?

Cardinal Alphonse Delacroix, also known as Alphons Draclau, is a antagonist of Final Fantasy Tactics. He was a famous knight of the Fifty Years' War as well as second-in-command of the Church of Glabados. He is the lord of Lionel.

From the ruling aristocracy of the territory of Lionel, Delacroix served as a knight during the Fifty Years' War, where he earned recognition and respect for his deeds as well as dedication to the faith of the Church of Glabados. After the conflict, he devoted his life to the Church, becoming an inquisitor after the murder of his wife and son by an Ordallian heretic, leading him to be admired for his service to the Holy Office of the Inquisition. Although Delacroix wished to renounce his noble hierarchical position to become fully a man of the Church, given that his new occupation as cardinal consumed his attention, the people adored him for his commitment, which led the Church and the Crown to persuade him to continue governing his region.

Though the exact circumstances and timeline of these events remain unknown, after gaining the Scorpio Stone and being possessed by Cúchulainn through it, Delacroix secretly began to follow the leadership of the Lucavi Hashmal, who was possessing Folmarv Tengille (the leader of the Knights Templar of Glabados), in an effort to revive the Angel of Blood, Ultima. Further corrupting the Church of Glabados and many of its high-ranking officials, the cardinal assisted Folmarv in his quest to find the remaining Zodiac Stones and trigger the War of the Lions between the two duchies of Ivalice.

During preparations for the conflict, Delacroix learned that the machinist Besrudio Bunansa from Clockwork City of Goug had the Taurus Stone. The cardinal then hired Ludovich Baert, leader of the multifaceted Baert Trading Company, to seize it. They captured Besrudio, but his son Mustadio escaped. Baert's mercenaries hunted him down, but he was saved by Ramza Beoulve and Agrias Oaks who were on their way to Lionel to seek shelter for Princess Ovelia.
